findings.finding: SuspendEE Begin is emitted before acquiring ThreadStore lock. Multiple initiators may log start before their work serializes.
RestartEE End is emitted after unlocking ThreadStore. A later initiator can begin/advance before the earlier end is emitted. Global process/CLR adjacency is not reliable episode pairing.

Debugger unsafe-place branch calls RestartEE(false), then goto retry_for_debugger below original Begin. It can emit restart phases before SuspendStop and later SuspendStop without another Begin. Fourphase state machine is not a universal runtime contract.

GC bridge forwards synchronous calls; reviewed workstation and background heap-zero paths support same-initiator sequences under their specific branches. Background dont_restart_ee_p and server rendezvous mean branch/caller coverage must be explicit; functions alone do not establish all paths.

Generated CoreCLR EventPipe writer calls EventPipeAdapter WriteEvent, then ep_write_event; ordinary write obtains current thread and passes NULL event_thread. Buffer manager uses writer thread when event_thread is NULL; ep_event_instance_init stores its OS thread ID. Sampling has separate explicit event-thread override. Thus ordinary EE event header is the emitter native thread under this source path, not a paused worker identity.

interpretation.same_initiator_83: Source-consistent observed fourphase candidates can be studied with stronger justification than earlier URL miss, but are not automatically accepted pause truth or universal GC coverage. Preserve all malformed/ambiguous episodes and original legacy results.
interpretation.outer_envelope: Begin->RestartEnd includes lock acquisition wait, suspension coordination and post-unlock work; it is not all-stop duration.
interpretation.inner_envelope: SuspendStop->RestartStart is a source-supported coordinated suspension observation for successful branch, not per-worker scheduler/CPU causality.
interpretation.acceptance_decision: Do not promote83 wholesale from existing source functions/metadata alone. Requires explicit applicable caller-path/build evidence, expected feature macros/GC mode, no retry/identity ambiguity for each episode, and captured binary/runtime mapping. No task lineage or kernel scheduler transitions are added by source review.

remaining_unknowns: Recorded commit source is not immutable proof of loaded binary equivalence or exact feature macros/build options.
Full GC server/background caller path coverage and retry absence are not certified by reviewing selected functions.
Runtime event loss0 is not proof all branch-specific expected phases exist.
Native initiator identity is not all paused thread identity; no exclusive GC/scheduler share or avoidable Engine work is established.
